## Current role

Nathaniel Whittemore is the Founder and CEO of Superintelligent and host of **The AI Daily Brief**, a daily video podcast/newsletter covering artificial intelligence news, analysis, and discussions. The show is distributed across YouTube, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and as a newsletter (aidailybrief.beehiiv.com). Whittemore hosts under the handle @nlw with approximately 68K followers on X. He founded Superintelligent in 2023; the company raised $2M in seed funding from Learn Capital to operate a platform teaching practical AI skills for business adoption.
